pinned_source.title: Exact Algorithms for General CNF SAT
pinned_source.license: No source-code license asserted; clean-room mathematical algorithm

contract.formula: CNF clauses preserve their input order; each input clause has 1..n literals and no variable repeats within a clause. Positive v is x_v and negative -v is not x_v.
contract.outer_recurrence: At each node shorten every clause to its first min(k,length) literals and test the resulting k-CNF. If unsatisfiable, visit clauses in source order; falsify the selected prefix, shorten earlier clauses, retain the selected clause tail and later clauses, simplify under the branch assignment, and recurse.
contract.bounded_subroutine: The exact k-CNF check is exhaustive enumeration of all assignments consistent with fixed variables, in lexicographic false-before-true order with x_1 first. This replaces the chapter's cited subroutine for the bounded profile; no cited time bound is claimed.
contract.assignment_mask: Bit v-1 is x_v; zero is false and one is true. A failed solve emits mask zero.
contract.trace: Calls/checks count recursive Procedure S invocations. Branch attempts count clauses visited at unsatisfiable nodes, including conflicting or non-progressing attempts that are skipped. The root depth is zero.
contract.profile_scope: Bounded deterministic Procedure S profile, distinct from the no-backtrack DPLL trace; no asymptotic running-time claim is made.

workspace.meaning: Bounded clause arrays, recursive formula snapshots, truth-table state, and staged 48-byte output for n<=5 and m<=6.
